component_findings.distribution_artifacts: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-1--python): Every sampled package across the frozen domain list shows releases or changelog entries within the 2026 calendar year, several within the last one to two months of the snapshot date, and most track new CPython release readiness within the same release cycle (3.14 classifiers already present for numpy, pandas, requests, cryptography, boto3, pytest, fastapi, aiohttp, pydantic per the pyreadiness.org cross-check).
